summary: Tilray Brands filed an 8-K attaching a legal opinion (Exhibit 5.1) related to an S-3 shelf registration (No. 333-290806). The prospectus supplement dated April 21, 2026 covers 398,666 shares of common stock to be sold by a selling stockholder. The filing is a routine procedural step for an already effective shelf registration; no merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or other special situation is described. The registrant is the issuer facilitating a secondary offering. No deal terms, premiums, or structural mechanics beyond the share count are provided.
